entries.verified_title: To Stay or Not to Stay in the Pre-train Basin: Insights on Ensembling in Transfer Learning
entries.version_verification: Saved HTML/text explicitly gives arXiv:2303.03374v3 [cs.LG] 15 Jan 2024.
entries.saved_takeaway: First fine-tune one target model, retain it as center, then train full models independently from its weights using cosine-cycle schedules. Pinned shared loop empties optimizer state by default and reloads first model weights; native reset differs from inherited warm Adam moments. More disagreement can accompany weaker members and worse OOD ensemble quality.
entries.relationship_to_GNNM_and_extension: Direct copied target-fine-tuned ensemble initialization ancestry. Native full-model rays differ from shared-W private-factor one-time graph-filtered CE-cotangent VJP expansion and its common-descent/functional/Armijo checks.
entries.attributed_prior_vs_open_gap: Attribute warm-copy branching and separation of target fine-tuning from diversification. The complete candidate operation can be a useful extension; held-out utility and originality remain unestablished. No exhaustive novelty claim.
entries.decisive_next_step: Add unchanged warm-copy GNNM continuation to a new prospective protocol amendment; optionally use warm untied copies as the quality reference for a broad copied-ensemble claim. Keep fixed raw-logit pool and equal tuning/cost accounting.
limitations: Inspected native code saves member probabilities; complete native ensemble reducer not resolved.
Pinned ResNet StarSSE config imports ResNetBaseConfig but declares BYOLBaseConfig; not runnable-qualified.
Native image schedules/benchmarks/costs do not transfer to admitted graphs.

entries.verified_title: FAGEL: Fast and Accurate Graph Ensemble Learning Using Staged Training and Diversified Sampling
entries.version: Publisher chapter preview first online 2026-09-08; ECML PKDD 2026; no arXiv version established.
entries.bibliographic_year_discrepancy: Publisher citation/copyright says 2027 while first-online/published date says 8 September 2026.
entries.saved_takeaway: Primary abstract/author README describe staged supervised graph training, varied hop/fanout sampling, selected full-model snapshots and residual weighted prediction aggregation. Pinned source confirms full GCN/Adam and selected raw-logit snapshots, but alternates samplers immediately and breaks at first plateau. Native aggregator has global learned model weights and tanh residual coefficient, with unused node-attention MLP.
entries.relationship_to_GNNM_and_extension: Near efficient staged graph-ensemble ancestry. Sampling changes/full-weight trajectory and learned fusion differ from one-time graph spectral cotangent-to-private-factor VJP expansion. Exact full-paper gradient/spectral algorithm is unresolved.
entries.attributed_prior_vs_open_gap: Attribute staged graph diversification and snapshot/residual fusion, without transferring reported large-graph efficiency or embedding-diversity theorem to the proposal. Source discrepancy prevents treating current repo as qualified native method reproduction.
entries.decisive_next_step: Preserve as attributed near prior. Resolve full paper/prose-code discrepancy in a separately versioned source amendment before any native FAGEL control. Do not alter fixed primary pooling or add a sampling/fusion grid to the present mechanism screen.
limitations: Publisher HTML is a subscription abstract preview; full method/proof/results not read.
Default inference=True path loads existing top checkpoints into a newly constructed Adam optimizer.
main contains commented calls only; README train.py absent in pinned tree.
Immediate alternating sampler/first plateau stop differs from abstract/README operation.
Raw-logit adaptive fusion changes native selector/cost contract.
